Rain armor not emitted as an armor set: two pieces only (no legs piece) and no set bonus — an ArmorSet needs a legs piece and a set bonus per helmet (the set infobox has no Set Bonus row; the article hosts 1 helmet(s), 1 chest piece(s) and 0 legs piece(s) — an ArmorSet needs ≥1 helmet and exactly one chest and one legs piece); its pieces carry no setId

Wizard set not emitted as an armor set: a combination set (one of two hats with one of eight robes, any legs) whose pieces live on their own articles — not one chest and one legs piece (the article hosts 0 helmet(s), 0 chest piece(s) and 0 legs piece(s) — an ArmorSet needs ≥1 helmet and exactly one chest and one legs piece); its pieces carry no setId
